summary: iter323 Safety Forms Portal Ownership Closure — backend RBAC fully verified (21/21 tests pass). Frontend anon redirect + legacy login banner + new Safety Portal tile + /safety-portal/forms-records list page all PASS. BLOCKING BUG: detail viewer ViewSafetyForm.jsx still uses legacy gate (isSafetyForms() || isAdmin()) — does NOT honor X-Safety-Token. Safety users get bounced to /safety/forms/login (legacy 1982 wall), which then triggers EnforcePortalScope to wipe their Safety token, cascading into a re-login loop. iter323 acceptance criteria for the drill-row flow and signed-in /safety/forms hub flow are unmet.

integration_issues.flow: Drill into Issuance/Training detail viewer from /safety-portal/forms-records as Safety user
integration_issues.issue: ViewSafetyForm.jsx line 42 `const authed = isSafetyForms() || isAdmin();` does NOT include isSafety(). Safety Portal users are bounced to /safety/forms/login (Navigate at line 57). Because /safety/forms/login is in EnforcePortalScope's ALL_LOGIN_PATHS, the Safety token is then wiped (clearAllSessions), breaking the session. Also, downloadPdf (lines 60-77) only sends X-Admin-Token + X-Safety-Forms-Token — never X-Safety-Token — so PDF download will 401 for Safety users too.

integration_issues.flow: Direct visit /safety/forms while signed in as Safety user
integration_issues.issue: Reproduces after the drill-flow above. After ViewSafetyForm bounces to /safety/forms/login, EnforcePortalScope wipes masci.safety.token. The next time the user visits /safety/forms, SafetyFormsHub's widened gate correctly evaluates isSafety()||isAdmin()||isSafetyForms() — but because the token was just wiped, all three return false, so it redirects to /safety-portal/login?from=safety-forms. The widened gate is correct in isolation; the breakage is upstream in ViewSafetyForm.

action_items: Widen /app/frontend/src/pages/ViewSafetyForm.jsx gate: replace `const authed = isSafetyForms() || isAdmin();` with `const authed = isSafety() || isSafetyForms() || isAdmin();` (import isSafety from '@/lib/safetyAuth').
In ViewSafetyForm.downloadPdf (~lines 60-77), also send X-Safety-Token header (read via getSafetyToken from @/lib/safetyAuth) so Safety users can download PDFs — backend already accepts it.

Change ViewSafetyForm.jsx line 57 redirect target from /safety/forms/login to /safety-portal/login?from=safety-forms for consistency with iter323 ownership model AND to avoid the EnforcePortalScope wipe of the Safety token. (Optional: keep /safety/forms/login as fallback for legacy SF-only users, but only if isSafetyForms session-token was the originating identity.)
After the fix, re-run the Playwright drill-row + direct-/safety/forms tests.
critical_code_review_comments: iter323's gate widening is incomplete — it covers SafetyFormsHub but NOT the detail viewer ViewSafetyForm. Same pattern needs to propagate to every legacy `isSafetyForms() || isAdmin()` check across the safety-forms page family (suggest grep: `isSafetyForms()` in /app/frontend/src/pages/).

EnforcePortalScope auto-wiping masci.safety.token when landing on /safety/forms/login is an undesirable interaction for Safety users — they should never end up there. Routing all unauthenticated bounces to /safety-portal/login (the new owner) avoids this entirely.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: iter323 widened the SafetyFormsHub gate but left ViewSafetyForm.jsx (the per-record detail viewer) on the pre-iter323 gate (`isSafetyForms() || isAdmin()`). When a signed-in Safety user clicks 'Open →' on a row in /safety-portal/forms-records, React Router navigates to /safety/forms/equipment-issuance/:id; ViewSafetyForm's gate fails because Safety token doesn't satisfy isSafetyForms(); it issues <Navigate to='/safety/forms/login' />; EnforcePortalScope sees the user landed on a login path (in ALL_LOGIN_PATHS) and calls clearAllSessions() — wiping masci.safety.token. The user is now de-authed, and every subsequent /safety/forms* visit bounces to /safety-portal/login. REPRO: (1) localStorage.setItem('masci.safety.token', <token>); (2) visit /safety-portal/forms-records (loads fine, 33 records); (3) click any 'Open →'; (4) observe URL becomes /safety/forms/login and Safety token is gone. MITIGATION: widen gate to include isSafety(), add X-Safety-Token to PDF download, and route unauthenticated bounces to /safety-portal/login?from=safety-forms instead of the legacy 1982 wall.
